notes.title: Hotfix 4.3
notes.notes:
Hello, Gliders!

We hope you're settling into the holiday season; maybe taking the time to ride around Midden and do some sand fishing? :)

Today we bring you a small hotfix, 

Happy gliding!

Bugfixes: 

 Keyboard users only: Fixed an issue that would cause re-assigned keys to not work correctly in the fishing mini-game. Note: In order for the fix to work on an existing save, you need to reset the assigned keys to default and then re-assign them again.
 Steam Deck: Re-added a few settings that were missing on the Steam Deck version.
 Fixed an issue where the achievement “Many Different Faces” was not unlocking at the correct time.
 Fixed an issue where some sounds were playing when they should be muted.
 Fixed a few issues with controller rumble
 Minor fixes

notes.title: Sable update sends you fishing in the desert
notes.notes:
In a game about someone navigating the competing pressures and existential angst inherent to choosing a career, it seems appropriate that an update would let them sack it all off and go fishing. Sable hasn't quite done that, because yesterday's update sends you hover-biking off after enough fish to earn the right to don the new, professional mask of a desert angler.
On your bike, then.
 Read more

notes.title: It's time to fish??? 🐟 Explore Midden in this new update for Sable.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/d94673abd498a293313358689acac21e0998c26c.jpg

Gliders!

Dismount and take a moment, feel the sand crunch beneath your feet and look out into the horizon. You find yourself in Sansee, just outside of Ewer canyon, searching for a fabled angler known as Yoshi. You hope to learn from them in hopes of earning the Angler Mask. 

With a new Vivarium to show off your fish and butterfly collection, what are you waiting for? Get catching those 🐟🦋!

We're proud and excited to announce that this update has added Japanese localisation along with a few more bug and UI fixes. Continue reading for more info.

Features

 New mini-game - Fishing: Sable can now catch fish in the sands of Midden by using a fishing rod
 New location - Angler Hut: An Angler has arrived in Sansee just outside of the Ewer canyon, where Sable’s journey first started
 New location - Vivarium: In The Wash you will now find the Vivarium and a Researcher who needs help completing their collection of fish and butterflies
 New mask - Angler Mask: If you help the Angler with their tasks, Sable can earn a new mask to wear
 Three new achievements: Quite the Catch, The Angler Mask and Vivacious Vivarium
 New bike parts, dyes & clothing
 Controller rumble
 Japanese localization

Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue that stopped camera movement during cutscenes
 Fixed an issue that would cause water ripple effects to follow Sable outside of water
 Fixed an issue that would cause audio artifacts when triggering multiple sounds simultaneously
 Fixed an issue that would cause the game to become unresponsive when changing resolutions on Steam Deck
 Adjusted the “Honorary Chum” achievement description to closer match the actual requirement
 Fixed some missing textures and floating objects
 Several UI bug fixes

/Raw Fury & Shedworks

p.s 🎁 Catch Sable discounted in the Steam Autumn Sale! 🎁

notes.title: Anniversary Week Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/c767503872a3b4f643113e90ac54e63826a4806b.png

Hello everyone,

Happy Monday! It’s been a year since Sable was released, and we continue to appreciate your feedback and work on optimization where we can. We’ve heard so many heartwarming stories of your experiences playing our game, and we hope, during this Anniversary Week, that you’ll continue to share them with us.

Let’s dive into our new additions to photo mode 📸; we’ve added new filters and poses to have fun with in Midden. Feel free to share your shots with us; we’d love to see them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/c0412b77e2d977e456559568aca567f37ff039d2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/95bc5f803369a51aa39ee8953b91be48b656d3fc.png

Had some fun with photo mode already? Well, I should also let you know what else is in this patch, so let’s not keep you waiting.

Features

 Poses and filters have been added to photo mode📸 - snapshots can now be even more customized

Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue that caused Sable to spawn in the wrong place if the player fast travels while on a ladder
 Fixed an issue that caused Simoon to malfunction if Sable gets off the bike while in the water
 Fixed a bug that caused world asset streaming system to produce bigger stutters than expected when playing on high framerate
 Fixed a bug that caused some world assets to be instantiated multiple times
 Fixed waterfall sound to correctly stop playing on unload
 Fixed water ripple particles
 Fixed map markers on new game

Optimizations 

 Reworked bird animations to reduce their impact on performance
 Reduced memory impact of terrain chunks
 Faster occlusion culling with less memory usage

 
Thank you for being so supportive. You might also be hearing a little more news from us soon… 🎣

/Raw Fury & Shedworks

notes.title: Hotfix 3.8.20
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Today we bring you a hotfix to help ease the camera issues/changes from our last update. Let us know how these changes feel!

Regarding performance issues or graphical hitches, please continue to let us know what you're experiencing via our  support desk . 

On to the details:

Bugfixes

 Fixed the bug where the camera pulls close to the bike when you drive over a dune.
 The bike shouldn't go off the top/bottom of the screen so easily now,
 The bike camera should generally be more stable now, especially when you bump into obstacles.
 Doubled the amount of time before the bike camera resets behind you.
 Fixed a bug where the driving camera wasn't affected by the FOV slider in the settings menu.
 Fixed a bug where the camera wouldn't immediately transition to Sable when alighting the bike.

Thanks again for your patience. We love seeing all the photos you've taken in the game; thank you for sharing them with us! 

 

/Raw Fury & Shedworks

notes.title: Photo mode update is here 📸Get snappin' on your travels!📸
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First things first, let's talk about the most hotly discussed topic right now for Sable, optimization!

So! We did promise a significant change with this newest patch but we bumped into some further issues that we want to take the time to overcome and get right. We have made progress with this update and welcome your feedback on how the game performs for you. We know it will be different for everyone, but we hope that most of you will notice a positive difference. Rest assured, we'll keep on tweaking and working on optimization with future patches.

For those of you who felt motion sickness whilst riding Simoon (or Sandcutter), we'd like to hear from you about how it feels now. The camera had some changes made to make the whole experience smoother.

Now for the fun part, Photo Mode! 📸

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/0a1b5a1b3e292d7e4e101faedc576ccb2de2a21a.png

Woo hoo! You can now take beautiful pictures of the world during your travels! Please note this mode has to be enabled in the settings menu before using it. Once enabled, the default buttons to enter Photo Mode are X on the keyboard and Up on the D-pad for your controller.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/c294500b81fd572416c74cbeb6a2c44eed9c8a10.png

A certain someone had too much fun taking shots on their widescreen monitor...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/ac2b80ba81b2f8e917775a4179a776d346438fcc.jpg

We would love to see all your beautiful pictures, and I've heard that we might even think of doing a little photo competition soon...!

Now onwards, to the updates!

Features

 Photo mode. Capture the perfect snapshot of your adventures in Midden! This mode has to be enabled in the settings menu before you can use it.
 Added antialiasing as a display option. It is enabled by default.
 Reworked the navigator to work more smoothly.
 Added a display option to resize the text in the game.
 Rebound keys in the menu to improve usability for international keyboards.

Camera

 Made several fixes to the camera. The biggest one: it should now follow Sable more smoothly while on the bike, which hopefully should prevent some cases of motion sickness reported by players. 

Performance

 Upgraded engine version to fix problems with frame pacing, which should reduce micro-stuttering.
 Optimized terrain rendering, AI agent simulation, culling readback, and virtual camera updating.
 Reduced texture memory usage.

Bugfixes

 Fixed mouse deceleration.
 Reworked the mechanic when Sable calls out to Simoon. 
 Fixed so that waypoints can no longer be placed outside of map boundary by mistake 
 All menus can now be closed with the Esc button 
 Fixed an issue that cause the map to be cut off in certain resolutions
 Fixed an issue that would cause the current quest to be unmarked when Sable collects an item
 Fixed an issue that would cause Sable to be forcefully teleported while approaching the Black Desert Cartographer's location.


Thank you again for your feedback and support, more is always welcome, and we'll read all the replies here and on the forum.

/Raw Fury & Shedworks

notes.title: Sable Patch 3.7.7 - Keybinding has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're thrilled to bring to you one of the most requested features for Sable, keybinding! You can now remap the controls for both keyboard and controller to your liking. We really appreciated your patience whilst we implemented this feature; thank you! ♥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/dfda0810657feb9c437ec4d08184b8202d5b1733.png

We also have some other bugfixes, text and UI changes, so without making you wait any further, here's the complete list of updates for Patch 3.7.7

Features

 Added key and button rebinding. To access this menu, go to Settings > Controls > Show controls.
 Added Windowed mode as a display option.

Text & UI

 Fixed an issue that would cause the Settings menu to become unresponsive.
 Fixed so that map markers can no longer be placed outside of the map.
 Several localization fixes.
 Fixed the swapped dialogues of Cartographers Charifa and Arzu.
 Visual improvements to the Navigator tool.
 Fixed issues with several locations on the map. Fast travel icons should now appear for Carab's Hold and Geyser Tower when the player has visited them.

Camera

 Improvements to prevent the camera from clipping through objects.

Audio

 Fixed an issue that would cause the ring shrine activation SFX to play unprompted while the player travels through the world.

Quests & Locations

 [Remnants of Change] Chime Maker Aeyan will now be present in Eccria even if the quest Heartbreak in the City quest has not yet been completed.
 [Heartbreak in the City] It is now possible to bribe the guard to let Sable enter Merchant Iria's office even after quest completion.
 [The Wyrm] Fixed so that the player is not locked inside if they skip the second trigger to make the water rise at the end of the Wyrm, as well as some visual fixes in this section.
 [Nozi's Nibbles] The player should now be correctly rewarded with a Merchant's Badge after completing the quest.
 [Ships of Old] The player should no longer be soft-locked if they save and exit in Sizo's workshop.
 [The Final Mask] Fixed an issue that would cause the in-game time to freeze if the player selected "Not yet" in the dialogue prompt upon approaching Ibex Camp.
 [Shadow of Neave] Fixed an issue that prevented the player from selecting dialogue options with the mouse.

As well as all of the above, we've applied additional fixes to objects, colliders, and textures in the game world.

We want to take a moment to mention our current sale for International Women's Day here on Steam. If you were waiting for keybinding or want to gift a friend the game, now's your chance with it currently at -35% off! We also have other awesome titles on sale so feel free to take a little peek.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/7320763fc2ca5ab33706e892c0bd22f85ea8b2a3.png

If you're still experiencing issues or bugs when playing Sable, please reach out to us via our support form. Your feedback helps us immensely when pushing out hotfixes and patches; thanks again!

 
/Raw Fury & Shedworks

p.s want to chat about Sable with other fans, why not pop by the Raw Fury Discord!

notes.title: Sable Patch 3.5.12 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We're here with a new patch for Sable that'll fix some of those pesky bugs and introduce performance updates.

Performance

Added a custom culling system to improve performance and frame rate across the game.

Settings

Slightly increased colour contrast for higher visibility by default. You can make further colour adjustments in the Display tab in the Settings menu.

Gameplay

Restored the Shade of Eccria symbol hints in Eccria. You should now find it easier to locate the item Maz told Sable about…

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue that causes Sable's masks to unequip when the player reloads the save.
Fixed several issues where certain sound effects would get stuck in an infinite loop.
Fixed an issue that could cause the Dunboyne puzzle to softlock after reloading a save game.
Fixed an issue that would cause Sable to get stuck inside the Palm Forest shipwreck after reloading a save game.
Fixed an issue that allowed the player to multiply objects through the merchant screen.
Fixed an issue that would cause the money tracker to remain on screen indefinitely.
Reduced the area where the lightning effects from the Crystal Plateau can be seen.
Improved the physics of the pistons that launch Sable into the air in the puzzle ships.
Additional fixes to objects, collisions, and textures in the game world.


Thank you so much for your continued support. As always, feel free to report any bugs here:  Raw Fury support

We've also heard on the winds that there may be some more patches incoming over the next couple of months. The breeze doesn't carry any specifics at this time, but we'll be sure to chat more about it when we can.

It's a busy holiday season, but please remember you're always welcome to unpack, relax and chill in these lands. 

From all at Raw Fury & Shedworks, happy gliding!

notes.title: Sable's Stranger Update unleashes a ghastly new bike and plenty of bug fixes
notes.notes:
I wasn't expecting Sable to get much in the way of post-launch content, never mind a Halloween update. And yet this week, developer Shedworks unleashed an eldritch new bike and costume on the deserts of Midden—though you'll have to be something of a ghost yourself to find them...
                Read more.

notes.title: The Stranger Update + Halloween Sale
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/7dda4838a202e6408783b46fd0b373d758cbd94a.png

A stranger’s rest near Redsee gates
On metal steed, heir of the Shade
The fullness of the mask awaits
Seek the hidden for nocturnal trade 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/f3dcecc243ced657197ecaef629d816e0a54576c.gif

Greetings everyone, 

Halloween is upon us and in time for this we’ve prepared a brand new update to fix some things in Sable, you’ll find the patch notes below. To further celebrate, Sable will also be available to buy at a 20% discount on Steam, limited to purchases made between October 28 and November 1, 2021. 

In Midden, one entity in particular strikes fear into the hearts of wrong-doers. So in the spirit of the season, we have added a new set of clothes and cosmetic bike customization for you to find in the game. It takes a bit of consideration as well as searching, but we're sure that curious Gliders will find it before long! The set is a permanent addition to the game, so there’s no urgency involved. 


Patch Notes

In this update, we have addressed the following:

New items: Spread fear as the Shade of Eccria!

 Sable can now acquire a full set of clothing and bike parts to go with her Shade of Eccria Mask. Can you find the secret merchant?

Bugfixes

 Improved cloth simulation, which should improve the performance across the game.
 Fixed an issue where the merchant buy & sell screens would sometimes lose functionality, and another issue that made it possible for Sable to sell more items than she owns.
 Fixed an issue where Simoon would fall through the world and disappear if the player tries to call for her from a very large distance. Simoon will no longer heed Sable’s call if she’s too far away, but at least she will stay put - better go back and get her! You can also reset Simoon's position at any time by fast traveling to another location using the Map.
 Moved Simoon’s map marker below Sable’s map marker, so you can now see in which direction you’re heading.
 Fixed an issue where the mouse would sometimes override controller input, rendering the player unable to make selections in the UI.
 The player can now exit the Navigator with Esc as an option to Backspace.
 Fixed an issue where the player could not select an unstarted quest with the mouse.
 Fixed an issue where the wrong tab would be highlighted in the settings menu.
 Fixed an issue where an autosave during the quest Sometimes a Well is just a Well would break Sable’s movement.
 Fixed an issue where Sable couldn’t choose the Scrapper’s Mask at the end of the game.
 Made adjustments to some areas where players reported Sable could get stuck.
 Improved the SFX for when Sable is prompted to sprint repeatedly.
 Additional fixes to objects, collision and textures in the game world.
 Additional fixes to UI.

Settings

 Added “Hold to Accelerate” accessibility option - this setting affects the acceleration of your hoverbike. When turned off, press acceleration once to start accelerating and second time to cancel.

/Raw Fury & Shedworks

notes.title: Patch 3.3.6
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are happy to tell you that we have just released a fresh new patch that will take care of the following:


 Improvements to stuttering and frame drops

Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where some players were unable to choose color palettes in the bike customization menu.
 Fixed an issue where Sable could enter Atomic Heart and get stuck inside. 
 Fixed an issue where players could break the sequence of the quest ‘Heartbreak in the City’, resulting in Sable losing movement. 
 Fixed an issue where the skybox would flicker at dusk and dawn.
 Fixes to NPC AI. Players should no longer encounter flying beetles and goats while traveling.
 Additional fixes and improvements.


Settings

 Added visual accessibility settings: FOV slider, line weight, high-visibility colour mode
 Added display quality settings: draw distance, shadow detail
 Players using mouse and keyboard can now press Ctrl to make Sable walk.


We are incredibly grateful to those of you submitting bug reports and again if you find any, please submit them here: Raw Fury support

The developers are continuing to work through the reports, and we will release more patches in due course and we appreciate your patience while we put the fixes in place.

We hope you are having fun with your Gliding!

/Raw Fury & Shedworks

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 60 fps!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32968006/c972d9b950427db0dcaa7f381a20019c5b8478af.png

Hey everyone, 

It’s been amazing and completely overwhelming seeing people play the demo, hearing your thoughts and getting feedback! The game is still a work in progress and we know there are some things that need ironing out for launch.

Having said that, we decided to push a hotfix for PC based on what we knew we could fix before Steam Next Fest ended. We have updated the following:


 Added a 60 fps option
 Camera sensitivity sliders now work in settings
 Mouse cursor is restricted to game window
 Fixed an issue that prevented players from exiting the cartographer’s shop menu. You should now be able to close it with Backspace on your keyboard, or the B button if you’re using a controller
 The pause menu now shows the correct keyboard prompt to close the screen


We are aware that there are other issues to address and fix - the aim is to get these sorted by release of the full game. The more work we do on the demo, the less time we have to work on the full release so at some point we have to shift focus.

This doesn’t mean we aren’t still interested in feedback you have on the demo. If you encounter any bugs we would really appreciate it if you submitted them to Raw Fury using this link: https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1

A final note - if you get stuck in geometry, lose your bike or get lost, once you have visited the camp you can go into the map screen and fast travel to the camp from anywhere.

Happy gliding
Gregorios Kythreotis

notes.title: Gorgeous sci-fi indie Sable will now release next year
notes.notes: If you've been eagerly anticipating the release of Sable since our first glimpse of it at last year's E3, sadly, you're going to have to wait a little while longer, as the game's release date has been moved back from 2019 to 2020.According to a press release from developer Shedworks, the scheduled 2019 release date was "an extremely rough estimate" and more time is required to allow the team to "fully realise the game we want to make"."When we started developing Sable in 2017, it was just Daniel and myself working in the shed," art designer Greg Kythreotis explained. "We had no support beyond my parents letting us use their shed, nor any idea where this project would lead us. All we knew was Sable was the kind of experience we dreamt for years of making. We started sharing the game very early on and the incredible reception we got meant that we very quickly got the backing of Raw Fury, and eventually Microsoft.Read more
